_readme: Schema and morning notes: src/content/SIMULATION.md. This file stays separate from edition.json. If storyId is not in today's edition, the block hides itself.
title: The quarter Reuters reported, set against the quarter before
intro: Switch between Anthropic’s third quarter and the quarter before it, using only the figures Reuters printed on 2 November from the amended S-1. The page does not invent the earlier quarter’s revenue, and it does not subtract the loss from the revenue.
note: Every figure on the control is from Reuters’s 2 November 2026 account of Amendment No. 1. Third-quarter revenue is $16.96 billion, up 47% from the quarter before. Reuters says revenue rose 144% in that earlier quarter and does not print it in dollars, so there is no revenue on that side. The third-quarter net loss is $23.29 billion, down from $66.3 billion. The operating loss is $567 million, after operating income of $974 million. Reuters says the operating line is the cost of running the business, and the net loss also includes convertible bonds. CNBC’s nine-month revenue of $33.24 billion and nine-month net loss of $104 billion are not on this control. Neither is the $895.4 billion of commitments. Reuters says about $69.8 billion of that is due in the 12 months after 30 September 2026. That is a commitment, not a quarterly result.
